summary: A tight combat beat with a clear escalation: Adel’s concentrated guidance disables the lead tank, then Sayed spots the incomplete rear kill and immediately redirects fire. Both lines are playable, period-appropriate and concise.

lines.speaker: ADEL
issues: The count is inherently generic and reveals little about Adel, but it works as focused combat behavior.

performance.delivery: Count almost soundlessly to himself, eye fixed to the sight. Keep each number tied to the missile’s slow flight, with no panic or triumph.

lines.speaker: SAYED

performance.delivery: Sayed catches the moving tracks and hurls the correction down the firing line. Make it gravelly and clipped: urgency without loss of control.

lines.text: الْأَخْرَانِيَّةْ لِسَّهْ مَاشْيَةْ! آرْ بِي جِي عَلِيهَا!
